summary: This bill nullifies a presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, that restricted the entry of certain nonimmigrant workers, specifically those with H-1B visas, and prohibits the use of federal funds to enforce it.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly nullifies a proclamation restricting the entry of certain nonimmigrant workers, specifically H-1B visa holders. This action would lead to more nonimmigrant workers entering the country, thus increasing immigration.
